newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 48,000 MT were off one-half from the previous week and the 4-week average. Primary increases for Saudi Arabia (52,000 MT), Australia (26,000 MT), El Salvador (14,000 MT), and Ecuador (13,000 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (97,000 MT, including 70,000 MT corrected to the 1997/98 marketing year).

Exports of 93,000 MT exceeded the previous week by 31 percent, but were 11 percent less than the 4-week average. Saudi Arabia (27,000 MT), Mexico (15,800 MT), and Egypt (15,400 MT) were the major recipients.
